scope_notes: The nested pyramid-db CodeQL database directory sits at the repository root (pyramid_vuln/pyramid-db), NOT under src/, so the structural src/pyramid/% scope guard in both extraction queries excludes it from code traversal, search and candidate extraction regardless of DB scope; repo-root files (setup.py, scripts, reports) and the tests/ tree are excluded the same way.

src/pyramid/testing.py and src/pyramid/config/testing.py are Pyramid's own testing helper modules (DummyRequest/DummyTemplateRenderer etc.); per the Augur noise policy (tests and fixtures) they are excluded from candidate extraction and documented here. src/pyramid/interfaces.py (zope.interface declaration stubs with no executable logic) is likewise excluded so interface method declarations are not mistaken for entry points.

Per experiment-independence rules, repository-root artifacts that look like ground truth (PYRAMID-VULNERABILITY-REPORT.md, path_traversal_sinks.csv, 漏洞审查报告.md, 第一步筛选报告.md) were NOT read; all findings below derive only from src/ code.

Dependencies (webob, zope.interface, pkg_resources/setuptools, plaster/plaster_pastedeploy, hupper, venusian, translationstring) are NOT in the DB; their APIs are matched syntactically by call-site name with module hints.

coverage_gaps: Dynamic dispatch / receiver-typing: pkg_resources functions are matched by dotted call-site names (pkg_resources.resource_*, self.pkg_resources.resource_*, bare from-import aliases in static.py); calls through aliased imports or re-bound references elsewhere would be missed. static.py's bare os.path aliases (exists/isdir/getsize/join/normcase/normpath) and response.py's (getmtime/getsize) are constrained to those files by an explicit file guard because from-import alias resolution is not modeled.
FileResponse is matched by call-site name (from pyramid.response import FileResponse at static.py:11); other import styles of the same class would be missed (only one call site exists in this repo).

OverrideProvider.get_resource_* / PackageAssetSource.get_* / FSAssetSource.get_* / PkgResourcesAssetDescriptor.* / FSAssetDescriptor.* are internal wrapper methods (propagation nodes), extracted only via their concrete underlying calls (open/os.path.*/pkg_resources.*); pure delegations to parent providers are matched as pkg_resources.DefaultProvider.* super-calls.

webob internals (Request.path_info/params/headers implementations) and pkg_resources DefaultProvider internals are external dependencies not present in the DB; their filesystem behavior cannot be traced further.
